requirements.requirement: The system must execute unit tests validating that specialty match reasoning is always ordered before any quality score reasoning.
The system must verify via unit tests that pass status renders a visible pass indicator in the triage component.
The system must verify via unit tests that fail status renders a visible fail indicator in the triage component.
The system must validate through UI tests that specialty explanation text is displayed when specialty match data is present.
The system must validate through UI tests that quality reasoning sections are displayed only after specialty reasoning.
The system must validate rendering for partial data scenarios where some reasoning blocks are missing but remaining blocks display correctly.
The system must validate rendering for missing specialty data where specialty explanation is absent and no placeholder breaks layout.
The system must validate that expandable reasoning sections toggle visibility correctly in UI tests.
The system must ensure that all triage component tests pass in the CI environment without runtime errors.
The system must validate that explanation text is not rendered when corresponding data fields are null or undefined.
The system must validate that incorrect ordering (quality before specialty) causes a failing unit test.
The system must validate that the triage component renders without crashing when API response is empty.
The system must validate that the triage component renders an error-safe state when API response structure is malformed.
